rarityBalance.claimProbability: one premium-gear decision per server-authorized genuine human participant final boss claim, after authentic boss victory source and eligible premium-reward entitlement; no extra rate per room, role, VIP, charge replay, party member or checkpoint
rarityBalance.bossVariantProbability: frozen 50/50 run selection from server authoritative source; 0.5 for the selected named source at new-run creation, never client rolled during receipt settlement
rarityBalance.categoryStage: once success any gear, select one of frozen boss's category weights, then choose one distinct item uniformly within that category; no reroll for player class/role, and no promised ownership duplicate protection
rarityBalance.perItemChanceFormula: (ratePct/100) × 0.5 × (categoryWeightPct/100) × (1 / countOfItemsInCategory) × 100 = unconditional % of eligible runs for that named source item, assuming honest 50/50 boss variant
rarityBalance.rolloutDecision: 8–10% chance for any premium gear (per-item fractions of 1%) is an explicit RECOMMENDATION only; do not activate without sample demand, price and future actual reward eligibility review. Old 3–5% candidate retained as comparison but superseded as v5 working model.
rarityBalance.pityAndDuplicatePolicy: none in this pass; any source-weighted duplicate protection could distort cross-class Market supply, requires separate owner approval
rarityBalance.damageAndStatBudget: one authored tier-appropriate innate %/pp per drop; unchanged rarity/quality RNG and approved affix count; never free proc or affix budget, original subtype verified
rarityBalance.simulationCaveat: expected drops = eligible boss victories × overall rate; historical successful claims are upper bound candidates, not confirmed future eligible source

productionObservation.definitions: count e.entitlement_kind='participant' AND e.reward_stage='final' AND e.claimed_at in window AND r.status='completed'; distinct account count; original acquisition of EQ2 premium gear currently not implemented
productionObservation.caveat: Historical successful dungeon reward participant claims (not proof of a boss defeat or proof of future premium loot eligibility). Expected items are arithmetic scenarios only. Early population is highly concentrated; no revenue or supply forecast is represented.

classAndSpecReconciliation.designRule: All 9 classes have exactly one source-authored class-specific weapon per dungeon. Role armor set families are affinities, not hard class locks; if a class can equip same item slot it can use relevant set, while meaningful 2p/4p effect requires valid corresponding damage, healing, debuff or defensive event. Hybrid and cross-role builds remain possible.
classAndSpecReconciliation.dangerFound: V4 damage-set wording for Shiverlake Cantorshard and future Ashlands Fenreaver referred to physical class ability hits and would make four-piece damage sets unusable for Hexweaver direct spells. V5 supersedes those TWO bonus descriptions for the eventual Combat 2.0 implementation; original V4 file retained for historical comparison.

damageSetCorrections.newVersion: V5 direct class ability damage including real direct spell hit
damageSetCorrections.effect: After two successful authenticated direct class-ability damage hits, the next successful direct class-ability damage hit within 6s deals +8% damage. Both spell and physical direct hits qualify, but no unrelated weapon subtype/status is inherited.

damageSetCorrections.newVersion: V5 direct class ability damage including real direct spell hit
damageSetCorrections.effect: After an authenticated successful direct class-ability damage hit, the next successful direct class-ability damage hit within 6s deals +9% damage. Both direct spells and physical abilities qualify; no DoT, reflected or proc recursion.

classAndSpecReconciliation.classSpecificWeaponSource: Original V4 weapon templates and subtype weights unchanged; valid class ID required at equip time and market purchase/claim where approved.
classAndSpecReconciliation.noMandatoryClass: Bosses allow multiple counterbuilds, not one mandatory class, weapon trait or pet; no equipment may automatically apply Blunt/Slash/Pierce penetration/bleed/stagger.
classAndSpecReconciliation.proofOnly: combat effectiveness requires authenticated DirectAbilityDamage / EffectiveDirectHeal / Debuff/Cleanse / PostMitigationDamage event, class/specialization and hit target identity; source not client claimed

sourceBalanceAndV2Gates.marketMinLevelConflict: Hidden Market PR #1055 has older V17 T4 market acquisition level52 and no T5+ gear; V4 dungeon T4 Sunscar wear level candidate42 is below existing Market T4 min52 and Sunscar region ends50. No inherited old-market level policy may silently block Sunscar dungeon equipment or auto-drop its wear level. Separate versioned EQ2 purchase+wear policy must be approved.
sourceBalanceAndV2Gates.intendedResolution: Keep Sunscar T4 proposed combat wear42 while review is pending; future EQ2 equipment-specific Market acquisition rule should use approved exact template and source-bound equip minimum, not blindly reuse original tier gate. The market must still reject buying if class/level gating is enforced by final policy, and allow sellers to list valid loot without meeting buyer wear level. Do not activate until reconciled.
sourceBalanceAndV2Gates.liveMarketState: V30 negative legacy fence exists on separate unmerged market branch but has NO positive EQ2 mint/ownership/market bridge. Current market item approval and all flags remain OFF.
sourceBalanceAndV2Gates.specialStatLimit: Innate only once; cannot double rarity- or quality-scale or appear as a free additional affix. T5 fixed innates generally about +2.5–3.1% or 1.5 percentage points before gear-specific slot/counterplay audit. Offhand signature procs share one original-hit proc budget with weapon where events collide.
